scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting,firestore:rules
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build && firebase hosting:channel:deploy preview
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project citl-rules-test 'vitest run --config tests/rules/vitest.config.ts'
scripts.test:functions: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project citl-fn-test 'vitest run --config tests/functions/vitest.config.ts'
